name: GB energy supply margins
value: No notice found; 5.9 GW winter margin
summary: No Electricity Margin Notice or Gas Margins Notice found in force on 24 Nov; NESO forecasts a 5.9 GW winter surplus
state: NESO's winter outlook, published on 23 Oct, expects British electricity supplies to remain secure, with a 5.9 GW surplus, about a 9.5% buffer over peak demand (NESO). NESO notes that Electricity Margin Notices are a routine tool used in most winters and do not in themselves signal a supply risk. Searches on 24 Nov found no Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice in force, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: Power and gas supplies are expected to be adequate this winter. NESO publishes system notices if margins tighten.
rubric_hit: Normal: no NESO margin or capacity market notice and no Gas Margins Notice found; 5.9 GW forecast surplus

sources.title: NESO — British electricity supplies secure this winter despite global instability

why: When gas or electricity margins tighten, Britain risks price spikes and, at worst, controlled disconnections in winter.
drivers: Gas imports and storage, wind output, interconnectors, plant outages, cold weather.

rubric.alert: A Gas Deficit Warning, a high risk of demand control notice, or demand control used.
rubric.watch: NESO issues an Electricity Margin Notice or capacity market notice, or National Gas issues a Gas Margins Notice.
rubric.normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins; no notices issued.
